Alan also provides viewers with some tips on sensory planting and creating home-made play equipment for children

Find out if any of the contestants manage to take home the perfect Christmas present by winning the Prize Pot and earning themselves a place in the elite group of people who can honestly say that they are smarter than 99 per cent of the nation

event.description: Comedian Tom Allen celebrates the chaos that occurs when making TV shows with unseen outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows.
